To discover Device Folders and run backups in the background, Lumen needs a few standard permissions.
Xiaomi / HyperOS requires enabling \'Autostart\' and setting Battery saver to \'No restrictions\' in App Info so backups can run in the background.
Samsung (One UI) requires setting Battery to \'Unrestricted\' and adding Lumen to \'Never sleeping apps\' in Device Care.
Oppo / Realme / OnePlus (ColorOS) requires enabling \'Allow auto-launch\' & \'Allow background activity\' in Battery usage.
Honor (MagicOS) requires setting App Launch to \'Manage manually\' and enabling \'Auto-launch\' and \'Run in background\'.
Vivo / iQOO (Origin OS) requires turning on \'Autostart\' and \'High background power consumption\' for Lumen.
Google Pixel / AOSP runs background backups reliably once Allow Background Activity is enabled above.
